method: Check ten representative ledger rows against the inherited design and documentation baseline, confirm that each claim is supported only at the documented or design-proposal level, and record the missing capture. No page was fetched and no reference build was run; this is a design/source-baseline consistency check, not a fresh web or runtime replay.

rows.claim: Summon opens with query focus and Escape returns focus to the same editor without changing its text.
rows.gap: No frozen Windows reference identity, no capture session and no focus instrumentation.
rows.next_capture_step: Seed procedure step 1: freeze the identity, create the dedicated synthetic profile and record the actual shortcut and editor identity before pressing it.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: The quickstart establishes a summon/search flow at category level. The focus and escape details come from our keyboard proposal. No Windows build, shortcut chord or focus result was observed.

rows.claim: IME confirm and cancel do not execute a result or dismiss the launcher while marked text owns the field.
rows.gap: No macOS capture host, no physical IME run and no key-event trace.
rows.next_capture_step: Seed procedure step 5: on a frozen macOS build, record the input source, composition state and every Enter/Escape effect in the dedicated profile.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: The OS input citation is a proposed, unfetched supporting reference for the platform composition contract; the specific key routing is our proposed contract. No physical Japanese or Pinyin input was exercised on macOS.

rows.claim: Escape closes the action panel, then the child view, restoring parent query, selection and scroll.
rows.gap: The exact escape layering and scroll/selection restoration are unknown for the reference build.
rows.next_capture_step: Seed procedure step 4: open a child view, open actions, press Escape twice and record each layer plus parent selection and scroll.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: The vendor quickstart documents an action panel but not its Escape unwind order. The parent-state restoration claim is explicitly ours and remains unverified.

rows.claim: A secondary action names the exact target/effect and reports a truthful toast.
rows.gap: No macOS action-panel capture and no evidence for toast content, duration or accessibility.
rows.next_capture_step: Use a reversible synthetic secondary action, record the confirmation text and the observed effect, then compare the toast with the actual state.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: The blueprint requires exact target/effect text and non-blocking feedback. Vendor documentation only establishes that actions exist; no toast wording or behavior was observed.

rows.claim: An installed app launches and a running app switches to a stable identity without shell interpolation.
rows.gap: No reference build, no synthetic installed apps and no process/window identity trace.
rows.next_capture_step: Seed procedure app-catalog step: register two disposable targets, launch and switch, and record process/window identity before and after.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: The Windows product page and quickstart establish app search/launch categories. Launch-versus-switch semantics and stable identity are our design requirements, not observed behavior.

rows.claim: Install/uninstall refreshes without restart and a missing target fails safely.
rows.gap: No macOS app install/uninstall fixture and no observation of ghost-entry handling.
rows.next_capture_step: Install and remove a disposable app while the launcher stays open, then activate the stale result and record the failure/refresh path.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: The vendor quickstart does not establish refresh timing or uninstall reconciliation. The requirement comes from the blueprint's app-catalog acceptance boundary.

rows.claim: Scoped roots, exclusions, symlink cycles and denied directories remain bounded and recoverable.
rows.gap: No reference indexing run, no synthetic symlink loop and no permission-denied trace.
rows.next_capture_step: Configure a generated root with an exclusion, symlink loop and denied folder; record progress, cycle termination and partial-state reporting.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: File Search documentation establishes scoped roots and optional content search. The proposed Windows ACL citation is supporting context for permission semantics, not a fetched verification. Neither source proves the reference app's cycle or denial behavior, so the bounded cycle/denial acceptance is explicitly attributed to EV-DESIGN-BLUEPRINT and remains unverified.

rows.claim: Units and date/time-zone calculations follow explicit tables and report dimensional errors.
rows.gap: No macOS calculation capture and no reference unit/date grammar.
rows.next_capture_step: Run generated unit conversions and a DST interval in a fixed time zone, then record every displayed and copied value.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: The manual index documents calculator categories but not unit/date grammar or DST behavior. The deterministic fixture policy is our design proposal.

rows.claim: The preferred opener is used when available and a missing opener fails clearly or follows a documented default.
rows.gap: No Windows quicklink capture and no removed-opener experiment.
rows.next_capture_step: Assign a disposable opener, open the link, remove the opener, repeat and record the actual fallback and message.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: Quicklinks documentation establishes app override/preferred opener categories. It does not establish missing-opener fallback or its message.

rows.claim: Emoji and symbol results expose useful accessible names, role and selected state to VoiceOver.
rows.gap: No macOS screen-reader run and no reference accessibility-tree snapshot.
rows.next_capture_step: Search a generated emoji and symbol with VoiceOver, record announced name/role/selection and verify the list remains navigable.
rows.baseline_consistency_notes: Vendor documentation establishes that emoji search exists. Apple accessibility documentation is a proposed, unfetched supporting citation for the platform contract. No VoiceOver session or accessibility tree was captured.
